logs: Day three. Or the same day again. The lights here never go off, so I sleep under the ones that buzz the loudest.
If you find this: the dark rooms are not empty. They are just waiting for you to stop looking.
I counted the doors on the way in. I have been walking back for hours. There are more of them now.
It does not walk. I have watched. It is just somewhere else every time I blink.
